## What problem does this solve?

Describe the use case. What Active Directory or helpdesk task are you trying to
get done?

## Proposed solution

What would you like the plugin to do? If it's a new skill, suggest a name and an
example invocation (e.g. `/aid:groups list IT-Admins`).

## Backend support

Does this rely on a backend endpoint that already exists, or would the AID
Helpdesk backend need a new one? (Skills should only call endpoints that exist.)

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Anything else that would help.
